text:
Which statement about ethanoic acid is correct?
A
Ethanol is reduced by bacteria to produce ethanoic acid.
B
Ethanoic acid reacts with magnesium to produce a salt of formula CH3COOMg.
C
Ethanoic acid and methanol react in the presence of an acid catalyst to produce
ethyl methanoate.
Ethanol reacts with acidified aqueous potassium manganate(VII) to produce ethanoic acid.
D
